title: Pure D.D.
summary: D.D. cards only, with generic staples; the page's Macro Cosmos and Monarch builds rely on cards from outside the archetype and are left out. The D.D. monsters banish themselves and come back: D.D. Seeker banishes one of your monsters until the next turn on either player's turn, and D.D. Survivor, Scout Plane and Patrol Plane return in the End Phase of the turn they were banished. D.D. Warrior Lady and Assailant banish whatever they battle along with themselves, and D.D. Crow strips the opponent's GY from the hand. D.D. Post, the newest card, pumps your monsters for each card type among your banished cards, banishes a card each turn, and places itself back on the field when it is banished. D.D. Sprite and Dark Dimension Soldier add a Synchro that revives banished DARK monsters.
main: D.D. Seeker
Quick Effect: banishes one of your monsters until the next turn's End Phase.
D.D. Survivor
Returns in the End Phase after being banished from the field.
D.D. Patrol Plane
Returns in the End Phase by banishing another card.
D.D. Scout Plane
Returns in the End Phase after being banished.
D.D. Warrior Lady
Banishes the monster it battles, and itself.
D.D. Crow
Hand trap: banishes a card from their GY.
D.D. Sprite
Tuner: banishes your monster to summon itself; the monster returns next turn.
D.D. Assailant
Banishes the monster that destroys it in battle.
D.D. Assault Carrier
Summons itself with exactly three of your cards banished.
D.D. Esper Star Sparrow
Protects your other monsters from targeting; returns on a direct attack.
D.D. Telepon
Banished: banishes D.D. Seeker from the Deck to summon it next turn.
D.D. Post
Newest card: pumps by banished card types, banishes a card each turn, comes back when banished.
D.D. Dynamite
Burns 300 for each of their banished cards.
extra: Level 5 Synchro: revives a banished DARK monster; burns for Set cards.
